video_title: Perk Wants an APOLOGY for LaMelo Ball

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes the Hornets' current team performance
quotes.excerpt: The Hornets are shit right now. By the way, Charles Lee, you better watch out.
quotes.quote: It wasn't a good trade. LaMelo Ball, he never played winning basketball. He's not a winner. The Hornets are shit right now. By the way, Charles Lee, you better watch out. You better watch out. This is a players' league, and the way that you're going with that old-school Larry Brown mentality, your resume is not that strong to be going at players. LaMelo Ball left the Hornets because him and Charles Lee didn't have a great relationship.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.excerpt: Jonathan Kuminga is a champion. Jonathan Kuminga rolled the dice on himself.
quotes.quote: LaMelo Ball got that team cooking. It is such a big huge deal when you're playing with a true point guard that looks to pass first and you're running those lanes knowing that I need to have my hands ready, knowing that if I'm cutting, I'm going to receive it. That is the key. Jonathan Kuminga is a champion. Jonathan Kuminga rolled the dice on himself. Everybody was like, why did you do that, who's your agent, all that shit. They have culture over there in Minnesota. They have a foundation.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson praises Jonathan Kuminga's growth and development
quotes.excerpt: I will also compliment him at the highest of levels for what he is doing right now.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to sit up here and absolve him of any of the situations and scenarios that he was in. But I will also compliment him at the highest of levels for what he is doing right now. I remember Chauncey Billups, he was in Boston, gets drafted by, didn't really fit, kind of just went to Detroit and then became Chauncey Billups. So you see it often times. Great players go to, Kyle Lowry, once he got to Toronto, he became Kyle Lowry like, you know, Hall of Fame champion. So this is what I'm saying, so for have a young player bounce around to a couple of spots and then become who they were, Joe Johnson. Joe Johnson was in, he was in Boston, did not play, sent him to Phoenix, he became Joe Johnson in Atlanta.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Channing Frye debate LaMelo Ball's tenure in Charlotte
quotes.excerpt: LaMelo Ball was not a winner in Charlotte. Now, that's not all his fault.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: LaMelo Ball was not a winner in Charlotte. Now, that's not all his fault. But if you're the face of the team or the face of the franchise and they give you an opportunity to win, you take on that credit. He was a loser in Charlotte.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: I don't know if they won a series, a playoff series. They went to the play-in tournament.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: So they lost in the play-in tournament. So he was not healthy. Stop. Then here we go, just the next thing, he lost. He lost it. Just acknowledge that.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye explains Minnesota's need for a true point guard
quotes.excerpt: Guess what does Minnesota need for the last three, four, five years? A true point guard.
quotes.quote: LaMelo Ball, we are not saying he is not a really, really good player. And guess what does Minnesota need for the last three, four, five years? A true point guard and a guy who can take over the ball from Ant with his not only his personality, but with his gameplay. So all of a sudden Minnesota gets leadership. You know what he does? He makes everybody else a role player. And so you talk about Kuminga, Kuminga is accepting his role and wanting to star in his role because he knows that there's room to grow.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins and Richard Jefferson argue about Golden State's championship success
quotes.excerpt: Does Steph and Golden State win their four championship without Jonathan Kuminga?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Does Steph and Golden State win their four championship without Jonathan Kuminga?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: You are a fucking liar. You are a damn liar.
